Robot on RIGHT HALF, calm very dark navy #07121C negative space on LEFT HALF for separately rendered UI title. Elegant Hackers 1995 computer-world atmosphere, inviting and accessible, cyan lighting, crisp 3D forms. This is an illustration asset, not a screen mockup.
